_COMMENT_EMPTY_SCENE: 2026-10-02 empty-scene (free-space) run for the E/H sign check of the recorded Huygens-surface fields (check_gprmax_poynting_sign.py). Derived from parms_cylindric_cookie_nofo_transmission.json (same grid, band, 5x5 MIMO geometry, transmission RX at z=-0.35). Differences: BELT.MATERIAL=AIR (no belt), SUT.MODE=SURROUNDING (no sample), FOREIGN_OBJECT.MODE=MATERIAL with MATERIAL=AIR (no object), DELETE_OUTPUT_FILES_AFTER_SAVE=false so the five em_sim_*.out files (one per TX) remain on disk. Run with MODE = 0; in __main__ the line 'if MODE == 0 or MODE == 1: PARMS_FILE = ...' overrides the parameter file, so point it to this file.
_COMMENT_AMP_PHASE_NOISE_FLOOR: Real-system detectability thresholds for analyze()'s amp_noise_floor_db/phase_noise_floor_deg, read into EMSimulation.amp_noise_floor_db/phase_noise_floor_deg in __init__ - see that comment for the full Cramer-Rao-bound derivation and SNR-assumption caveat. These are placeholders (30 dB assumed per-bin SNR), not a vendor spec - replace with values derived from this sensor's actual noise figure/link budget once known.
_COMMENT_MIMO_GEOMETRY: N_TX transmitters fire sequentially (one gprMax simulation each); all N_RX receivers listen to every firing (see EMSimulation.py's _determine_electrical_fields_at_receiver()). TX_POS_RANGE's two x-offsets place all transmitters strictly LEFT of the sample's center axis (x < 0); RX_POS_RANGE places the receiver array strictly RIGHT of center (x > 0), mirrored about x=0 - adjust these four numbers together to keep that symmetry if you change the geometry. MIMO virtual-array spacing convention: RX elements spaced at lambda/2 (1.8506mm, computed at 81GHz, the band's highest frequency/smallest wavelength, as the conservative design point so the condition holds across the whole 77-81GHz band); TX elements spaced at N_RX*lambda/2 = 5*1.8506mm = 9.2529mm, so the combinatorial TX-RX virtual array is itself uniformly filled at lambda/2, synthesizing a larger effective aperture from 5+5 real elements. The 5mm near-center clearance on both sides is preserved from the prior design.
